title: LaGRA Trial in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: This study investigated the effectiveness of a surgeon administered, laparoscopic guided, regional anaesthesia technique.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing laparoscopic cholecystectomy
* ASA I, II or III

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients that don't consent to be included
* Allergy to levobupivacaine
